questions.q:
What is the length of perpendicular from point (8, -3) on the line 4y = 3x + 14?

रेखा 4y = 3x + 14 पर बिंदु (8, -3) से अभिलम्ब की लम्बाई कितनी है?
questions.s:
The formula for finding the foot of perpendicular from point (x1, y1) on the line (ax + by + c = 0) is-

(x - x1)/a = (y - y1)/b = -(ax1 + by1 + c)/(a2 + b2)

(ax + by + c = 0) = (3x - 4y + 14) and (x1, y1) = (8, -3)

After comparing-

a = 3, b = -4, c = 14, x1 = 8 and y1 = -3

From the equation-

(x - 8)/3 = (y + 3)/(-4) = -[3 * 8 + (-4) * (-3) + 14]/[32 + (-4)2

(x - 8)/3 = (y + 3)/(-4) = -2

(x - 8)/3 = -2

(x - 8) = -6

x = 2

(y + 3)/(-4) = -2

(y + 3) = 8

y = 5

Required co-ordinates = (x, y) = (2, 5)

Distance between two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2)-

√[(x2 - x1)2+ (y2 - y1)2]

Required distance = √[(8 - 2)2+ (-3 - 5)2] = = √[62+ 82] = 10 unit

Alternative Solution:

Length of perpendicular from point (x1, y1) on the line ax+by+c = 0 is │ax1+by1+c│/√[a2+ b2]

= │3*8-4*-3+14│/√[32+ 42]

= 10

questions.q:
If total questions in exam was 120, then what is the number of questions asked in the exam was from Civics section?

यदि परीक्षा में कुल 120 प्रश्न थे, तो परीक्षा में नागरिक शास्त्र से पूछे गए प्रश्नों की संख्या कितनी थी?
questions.s:
Total questions in exam = 120

Total number of questions asked from Civics section = 120 * (72/360) = 24

questions.q:
Total number of questions asked from Geography section exceeds by how much from questions asked in History section if questions from Polity section is 30.

यदि राजनीति विज्ञान विषय में 30 प्रश्न हैं, तो इतिहास विषय से पूछे गए प्रश्नों से भूगोल विषय से पूछे गए कुल प्रश्नों की संख्या कितनी अधिक है?
questions.s:
Total questions from Polity section = 900 = 30

Total number of questions from Geography section = 30 * (54/90) = 18

Total number of questions from History section = 30 * (36/90) = 12

Required difference = 18 - 12 = 6

questions.q:
Total questions asked from Polity and Civics section together is what per cent of total number of questions asked in the exam?

संयुक्त रूप से राजनीति विज्ञान और नागरिक शास्त्र विषयों से पूछे गए कुल प्रश्न, परीक्षा में पूछे गए कुल प्रश्नों का कितने प्रतिशत हैं?
questions.s:
Total questions asked from Polity and Civics section together = 900 + 720 = 1620

Total number of questions asked in the exam = 3600

Required per cent = (162/360) * 100 = 45%

questions.q:
Total questions asked from Current Affairs section is 18, then what is the difference between total questions asked from History and Polity?

समसामयिकी विषय से पूछे गए कुल प्रश्न 18 हैं, तो इतिहास और राजनीति विज्ञान विषयों से पूछे गए कुल प्रश्नों के बीच का अंतर कितना है?
questions.s:
Total questions from Current Affairs section = 18

Total questions from History = 18 * (36/54) = 12

Total questions from Polity = 18 * (90/54) = 30

Required difference = 30 - 12 = 18

questions.q:
If y/x + x/y = 2, what is the value of (5x - 2y)/3y? [x, y ≠ 0]

यदि y/x + x/y = 2 है, तो (5x - 2y)/3y का मान क्या है? [x, y ≠ 0]

The number of pigeons in a farm is 25% greater than the number of cows and 20% lesser than the number of goats. If the farm has only pigeons, cows and goats and the number of legs in the farm is 1020, what is the sum of the number of pigeons and goats?

एक फार्म में कबूतरों की संख्या गायों की संख्या से 25% अधिक और बकरियों की संख्या से 20% कम है| यदि फार्म में केवल कबूतर, गाय और बकरी हैं और फार्म में पैरों की संख्या 1020 है, तो कबूतरों और बकरियों की संख्या का योग कितना है?
questions.s:
Let the number of pigeons in the farm be 'x'

Number of cows in the farm = (100/125)*x = 4x/5

Number of goats in the farm = (100/80)*x = 5x/4

So, 2x + 4*(4x/5) + 4(5x/4) = 1020

=> 2x + 16x/5 + 5x = 1020

=> 35x + 16x = 1020*5

=> 51x = 1020*5

=> x = 100

Sum of the number of pigeons and goats = x + 5x/4 = 100 + (5/4)*100 = 225

questions.q:
Amit's age 6 years from now will be 26 years more than 75% of the age of Amit 12 years ago. What is his present age?

अब से 6 वर्ष बाद अमित की आयु 12 वर्ष पहले अमित की आयु के 75% से 26 वर्ष अधिक होगी। उसकी वर्तमान आयु कितनी है?

From 40 litres of pure alcohol, 4 litres is taken out and replaced with water. This process is done one more time and then 1.8 litres of alcohol is added. What is the final ratio of alcohol and water in the solution?

40 लीटर शुद्ध अल्कोहल से 4 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। इस प्रक्रिया को एक बार और किया जाता है तथा इसके बाद 1.8 लीटर अल्कोहल डाली जाती है। घोल में अल्कोहल और पानी का अंतिम अनुपात कितना है?
questions.s:
After replacing with water 2 times and before adding 1.8 litres of alcohol

Quantity of alcohol in the solution = 40(1 - 4/40)2 = 32.4 litres

Quantity of water in the solution = 40 - 32.4 = 7.6 litres

Final quantity of alcohol in the solution = 32.4 + 1.8 = 34.2 litres

Required ratio = 34.2:7.6 = 9:2

questions.q:
If 4B/A = 3C/A = 12, then what is the value of (1/A): (1/B): (1/C)?

यदि 4B/A = 3C/A = 12 है, तो (1/A): (1/B): (1/C) का मान क्या है?

What is the simplified form of 24 ÷ 3 of (21 ÷ 14 of 18) + 36 - 20% of 75?

(21 ÷ 18 का 14) का 24 ÷ 3 + 36 - 75 का 20% का सरलीकृत रूप क्या है?

If 5z1y9 is divisible by 9, then find the minimum value of (y + z).

यदि 5z1y9, 9 से विभाज्य है, तो (y + z) का न्यूनतम मान ज्ञात करें|
questions.s:
5z1y9 is divisible by 9 means sum of all digits of given number is divisible by 9., i.e.,

= (5 + z + 1 + y + 9) is divisible by 9

= (15 + z + y) is divisible by 9

Multiple of 9 which is greater than 15 is 18.

So, minimum value of (y + z) = 18 - 15 = 3

questions.q:
One root of equation x2 - px + q = 0 is (8 - 5√2), then what is the value of 'p + q'?

समीकरण x2 - px + q = 0 का एक मूल (8 - 5√2) है, तो 'p + q' का मान कितना है?
questions.s:
If one root of equation is (8 - 5√2), then other roots must be (8 + 5√2).

Equation whose roots are (8 - 5√2) and (8 + 5√2) = x2 - sum of roots * x + Product of roots = 0

Sum of the roots = (8 - 5√2) + (8 + 5√2) = 16

Product of the roots = (8 - 5√2) * (8 + 5√2) = 64 - 50 = 14

Required equation = x2 - 16x + 14

After comparing, p = 16 and q = 14

Required answer = 'p + q' = 16 + 14 = 30

questions.q:
The angle of elevation of the tip of the shadow of a tree with respect to the top of the tree of height 6m is 30°. After 30 minutes, the angle of elevation of the same becomes 60°. What is the change in the length of the shadow in this duration?

6 मीटर ऊंचाई के पेड़ के शीर्ष के संबंध में उस पेड़ की छाया की नोक का उन्नयन कोण 30° है। 30 मिनट के बाद, उसका उन्नयन कोण 60° हो जाता है। इस अवधि में छाया की लंबाई में कितना परिवर्तन होता है?
questions.s:
In triangle ABC,

tan30° = 6/BC

=> BC = 6√3

in triangle ABD,

tan60° = 6/BD

=> BD = 6/√3 = 2√3

Change in length of shadow = CD = BC-BD = 4√3m

questions.q:
A sum of Rs. 1230 is borrowed at 5% C.l. interest for 2 years on the condition that it is refunded in 2 equal installments one at the end of the first year & the other at the end of the second. What is the

amount of each installment.

1230 रुपये की एक धनराशि को 2 वर्षो के लिए 5% की दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार लिया जाता है, जिस पर शर्त यह है कि यह 2 बराबर किस्तों अर्थात पहली किस्त को वर्ष के अंत में और दूसरी किस्त को दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में वापस किया जाना है। प्रत्येक किस्त की धनराशि कितनी है?
questions.s:
Let the installments be Rs. x each

Amount to be refunded = 1230(1 + 5/100)2 = 1356.075

x(1 + 5/100) + x = 1356.075

x = Rs. 661.50

questions.q:
The average of three positive integers A, B and C is equal to an integer D. The average of A and D is another integer E. If the average of A and C is 5 more than E, what is the difference between D and the average of A and B?

तीन धनात्मक पूर्णांकों A, B और C का औसत एक पूर्णांक D के बराबर है। A और D का औसत एक अन्य पूर्णांक E है। यदि A और C का औसत E से 5 अधिक है, तो D और A तथा B के औसत के बीच का अंतर कितना है?

If a = (√6+ 1)/(√6-1) and b = (√6- 1)/(√6+1) Then what is the value of (a2 + b2 + ab )/(a2 + b2- ab ) ?

यदि a = (√6+ 1)/(√6-1) और b = (√6- 1)/(√6+1) है, तो (a2 + b2 + ab )/(a2 + b2- ab ) का मान कितना है?
o: None of theseइनमें से कोई नहीं
questions.s:
We can see that; a = (√6+ 1)/(√6-1) X (√6+ 1)/(√6+1)=(7+2√6)/5

Similarly; b = (√6- 1)/(√6+1) X (√6- 1)/(√6-1)=(7-2√6)/5

Since a and b are inverse of each other hence ab = 1

Now; a2 + b2 + ab = ((7+2√6)/5)2 + ((7-2√6)/5)2 + 1 = 171/25

In the same way; a2 + b2 - ab = ((7+2√6)/5)2 + ((7-2√6)/5)2 - 1 =121/25

Hence required value = 171/121

questions.q:
If a rectangular sheet of paper having sides 15 cm and 44 cm is shaped in the form of a cylinder such that the side of length 15 cm becomes height of cylinder, then what will be the volume of cylinder?

यदि कागज की एक आयताकार शीट जिसकी भुजाएं 15 सेंटीमीटर और 44 सेंटीमीटर हैं, जिसे एक बेलन का आकार इस तरह से दिया जाता है कि 15 सेंटीमीटर लंबाई की भुजा बेलन की ऊंचाई बन जाती है, तो बेलन का आयतन कितना होगा?
o: 2310 cm32310 घन सेंटीमीटर
2210 cm32210 घन सेंटीमीटर
2020 cm32020 घन सेंटीमीटर
None of the aboveउपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.s:
After converting in to a cylinder, 44 cm is the circumference of the cylinder.

Radius= (44/(2π)) = 7 cm.

Volume of cylinder= π x (7 x 7) x 15 = 22 x 7 x 15 =330 x 7 = 2310 cm3

questions.q:
What is the value of expression Tan2θ + Cot2θ - Sec2θCosec2θ?

अभिव्यक्ति का मान क्या है :

Tan2θ + Cot2θ - Sec2θCosec2θ?
questions.s:
Tan2θ + Cot2θ - Sec2θCosec2θ

=> Sin2θ/Cos2θ + Cos2θ/Sin2θ - 1/Cos2θ * 1/Sin2θ

=> [Sin4θ + Cos4θ - 1]/Sin2θ Cos2θ

=> [Sin4θ + Cos4θ + 2Sin2θCos2θ - 1 - 2Sin2θCos2θ]/Sin2θ Cos2θ

=> [(Sin2θ + Cos2θ)2 - 1 - 2Sin2θCos2θ]/Sin2θCos2θ

=> (-2Sin2θCos2θ)/Sin2θCos2θ

=> -2

questions.q:
In the following figure AP and AQ are two tangents and point O is the centre of the circle. Find the angle between tangent AP and AQ.

निम्नलिखित आकृति में AP और AQ दो स्पर्शरेखा हैं और बिंदु O वृत्त का केंद्र है। स्पर्शरेखा AP और AQ के बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
∠OPQ = 350 (Given)

∠OPQ = ∠OQP = 350 (Angles opposite to equal sides are also equal)

∠POQ = 1800 - 350 - 350 = 1100

∠PAQ = 1800 - ∠POQ (In quadrilateral PAQO, ∠OQA = ∠OPA = 900)

∠PAQ = 1800 - 1100 = 700

questions.q:
A shopkeeper marks his goods in such a way that the profit on sale of 30 refined oil packets is equal to the selling price of 15 refined oil packets. What is his profit percentage?

एक दुकानदार अपने वस्तुओं को इस तरह से चिह्नित करता है कि 30 रिफाइंड तेल पैकेटों के बिक्री पर लाभ 15 रिफाइंड तेल पैकेटों के विक्रय मूल्य के बराबर है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत कितना होगा?
questions.s:
Let cost price of 1 refined oil packet be C

Let selling price of 1 refined oil packet be S

According to question:

30*(S - C) = 15*S

2S - 2C = S

S = 2C

Profit percent = (S-C)/C * 100 = (2C - C)/C * 100 = 100 %

questions.q:
If 20 men worked for 5 hours a day, they can build a 190 feet long wall in 10 days. If after working for 6 days, 4 men leave the job, then how many days will be required to complete rest of the job if the number of working hours per day is the same?

यदि 20 पुरुष प्रतिदिन 5 घंटे काम करते हैं, तो वे 10 दिनों में 190 फीट लंबी दीवार बना सकते हैं। यदि 6 दिनों के लिए काम करने के बाद, 4 पुरुष नौकरी छोड़ देते हैं और यदि प्रति दिन काम के घंटे की संख्या समान है, तो बाकी काम को पूरा करने के लिए कितने दिनों की आवश्यकता होगी?
questions.s:
20 men working 5 hours of a day can build a wall in 10 days.

These 20 men worked for 6 days. This implies that they have built 6/10 i.e., 60% of the wall in 6 days.

Since, the length of the wall is 190 feet, part of wall completed in 6 days = 0.6 X 190 = 114 feet

Now, Amount of wall still left = 190 - 114 = 76 feet.

Also, the number of men left = 20 - 4 = 16

The rate of working is same in both the cases.

Let the number of days now required be D.

114/76 = (20 X 5 X 6)/(16 X 5 X D)

D = 5 days

questions.q:
What is the unit digit of 31286 + 12529?

31286 + 12529 का इकाई का अंक क्या है?
questions.s:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

NumberCyclicityUnit digit values
Power 1Power 2Power 3Power 4
010
111
242486
343971
4246
515
616
747931
848426
9291

(Note: remainder = power. When remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

In 31286:

Unit digit of 312 is 2.

286: From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 2 is 4.

86/4 remainder =2 = power 2

So, unit digit of 31286 = 4

In 12529:

Unit digit of 125 is 5.

529: From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 5 is 1.

Unit digit of 12529 = 5

Therefore, unit digit of 31286 + 12529 = unit digit of (4 + 5) = 9

questions.q:
Sum of two numbers is equal to sum of square of 15 and cube of 7. One of the numbers is 52 less than square of 18. What is the value of the square of the difference between the numbers?

दो संख्याओं का योग, 15 के वर्ग और 7 के घन के योग के बराबर है। संख्याओं में से एक संख्या 18 के वर्ग से 52 कम है। संख्याओं के बीच के अंतर के वर्ग का मान क्या है?
questions.s:
Let the numbers be a and b.

a+b = 152 + 73 = 225+343 = 568

a = 182 - 52 = 272

=> b = 296

Required number = (296-272)2 = 576

questions.q:
In a 4 km race on a course of 250 m round, A overlaps B in the middle of his 5th round. By what distance will A win at the same rate of running? Given that they start simultaneously from same point and in the same direction.

250 मीटर के वृत्ताकार ट्रैक पर 4 किमी की दौड़ में, A अपने 5वें राउंड के बीच में B को पछाड़ देता है। दौड़ने की समान दर पर A कितनी दूरी से जीतेगा? यह दिया गया है कि वे समान बिंदु से और समान दिशा में एक साथ शुरू करते हैं।
o: None of theseइनमें से कोई नहीं
questions.s:
A overlaps B in the middle of his 5th round.

So, when A runs 4(1/2) rounds, B runs only 3(1/2) rounds

(A's speed/ B's speed) = (4(1/2) / 3 (1/2)) = 9/7

When A runs 4 km, B runs 4 * (7/9) = 28/9 km

A wins by (4 - 28/9) = 8/9 km

questions_hin.q_hi:
What is the length of perpendicular from point (8, -3) on the line 4y = 3x + 14?

रेखा 4y = 3x + 14 पर बिंदु (8, -3) से अभिलम्ब की लम्बाई कितनी है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
The formula for finding the foot of perpendicular from point (x1, y1) on the line (ax + by + c = 0) is-

(x - x1)/a = (y - y1)/b = -(ax1 + by1 + c)/(a2 + b2)

(ax + by + c = 0) = (3x - 4y + 14) and (x1, y1) = (8, -3)

After comparing-

a = 3, b = -4, c = 14, x1 = 8 and y1 = -3

From the equation-

(x - 8)/3 = (y + 3)/(-4) = -[3 * 8 + (-4) * (-3) + 14]/[32 + (-4)2

(x - 8)/3 = (y + 3)/(-4) = -2

(x - 8)/3 = -2

(x - 8) = -6

x = 2

(y + 3)/(-4) = -2

(y + 3) = 8

y = 5

Required co-ordinates = (x, y) = (2, 5)

Distance between two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2)-

√[(x2 - x1)2+ (y2 - y1)2]

Required distance = √[(8 - 2)2+ (-3 - 5)2] = = √[62+ 82] = 10 unit

Alternative Solution:

Length of perpendicular from point (x1, y1) on the line ax+by+c = 0 is │ax1+by1+c│/√[a2+ b2]

= │3*8-4*-3+14│/√[32+ 42]

= 10

questions_hin.q_hi:
Total questions asked from Current Affairs section is 18, then what is the difference between total questions asked from History and Polity?

समसामयिकी विषय से पूछे गए कुल प्रश्न 18 हैं, तो इतिहास और राजनीति विज्ञान विषयों से पूछे गए कुल प्रश्नों के बीच का अंतर कितना है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Total questions from Current Affairs section = 18

Total questions from History = 18 * (36/54) = 12

Total questions from Polity = 18 * (90/54) = 30

Required difference = 30 - 12 = 18

questions_hin.q_hi:
If y/x + x/y = 2, what is the value of (5x - 2y)/3y? [x, y ≠ 0]

यदि y/x + x/y = 2 है, तो (5x - 2y)/3y का मान क्या है? [x, y ≠ 0]

The number of pigeons in a farm is 25% greater than the number of cows and 20% lesser than the number of goats. If the farm has only pigeons, cows and goats and the number of legs in the farm is 1020, what is the sum of the number of pigeons and goats?

एक फार्म में कबूतरों की संख्या गायों की संख्या से 25% अधिक और बकरियों की संख्या से 20% कम है| यदि फार्म में केवल कबूतर, गाय और बकरी हैं और फार्म में पैरों की संख्या 1020 है, तो कबूतरों और बकरियों की संख्या का योग कितना है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the number of pigeons in the farm be 'x'

Number of cows in the farm = (100/125)*x = 4x/5

Number of goats in the farm = (100/80)*x = 5x/4

So, 2x + 4*(4x/5) + 4(5x/4) = 1020

=> 2x + 16x/5 + 5x = 1020

=> 35x + 16x = 1020*5

=> 51x = 1020*5

=> x = 100

Sum of the number of pigeons and goats = x + 5x/4 = 100 + (5/4)*100 = 225

questions_hin.q_hi:
Amit's age 6 years from now will be 26 years more than 75% of the age of Amit 12 years ago. What is his present age?

अब से 6 वर्ष बाद अमित की आयु 12 वर्ष पहले अमित की आयु के 75% से 26 वर्ष अधिक होगी। उसकी वर्तमान आयु कितनी है?

From 40 litres of pure alcohol, 4 litres is taken out and replaced with water. This process is done one more time and then 1.8 litres of alcohol is added. What is the final ratio of alcohol and water in the solution?

40 लीटर शुद्ध अल्कोहल से 4 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। इस प्रक्रिया को एक बार और किया जाता है तथा इसके बाद 1.8 लीटर अल्कोहल डाली जाती है। घोल में अल्कोहल और पानी का अंतिम अनुपात कितना है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
After replacing with water 2 times and before adding 1.8 litres of alcohol

Quantity of alcohol in the solution = 40(1 - 4/40)2 = 32.4 litres

Quantity of water in the solution = 40 - 32.4 = 7.6 litres

Final quantity of alcohol in the solution = 32.4 + 1.8 = 34.2 litres

Required ratio = 34.2:7.6 = 9:2

questions_hin.q_hi:
If 4B/A = 3C/A = 12, then what is the value of (1/A): (1/B): (1/C)?

यदि 4B/A = 3C/A = 12 है, तो (1/A): (1/B): (1/C) का मान क्या है?

What is the simplified form of 24 ÷ 3 of (21 ÷ 14 of 18) + 36 - 20% of 75?

(21 ÷ 18 का 14) का 24 ÷ 3 + 36 - 75 का 20% का सरलीकृत रूप क्या है?

If 5z1y9 is divisible by 9, then find the minimum value of (y + z).

यदि 5z1y9, 9 से विभाज्य है, तो (y + z) का न्यूनतम मान ज्ञात करें|
questions_hin.s_hi:
5z1y9 is divisible by 9 means sum of all digits of given number is divisible by 9., i.e.,

= (5 + z + 1 + y + 9) is divisible by 9

= (15 + z + y) is divisible by 9

Multiple of 9 which is greater than 15 is 18.

So, minimum value of (y + z) = 18 - 15 = 3

questions_hin.q_hi:
One root of equation x2 - px + q = 0 is (8 - 5√2), then what is the value of 'p + q'?

समीकरण x2 - px + q = 0 का एक मूल (8 - 5√2) है, तो 'p + q' का मान कितना है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
If one root of equation is (8 - 5√2), then other roots must be (8 + 5√2).

Equation whose roots are (8 - 5√2) and (8 + 5√2) = x2 - sum of roots * x + Product of roots = 0

Sum of the roots = (8 - 5√2) + (8 + 5√2) = 16

Product of the roots = (8 - 5√2) * (8 + 5√2) = 64 - 50 = 14

Required equation = x2 - 16x + 14

After comparing, p = 16 and q = 14

Required answer = 'p + q' = 16 + 14 = 30

questions_hin.q_hi:
The angle of elevation of the tip of the shadow of a tree with respect to the top of the tree of height 6m is 30°. After 30 minutes, the angle of elevation of the same becomes 60°. What is the change in the length of the shadow in this duration?

6 मीटर ऊंचाई के पेड़ के शीर्ष के संबंध में उस पेड़ की छाया की नोक का उन्नयन कोण 30° है। 30 मिनट के बाद, उसका उन्नयन कोण 60° हो जाता है। इस अवधि में छाया की लंबाई में कितना परिवर्तन होता है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
In triangle ABC,

tan30° = 6/BC

=> BC = 6√3

in triangle ABD,

tan60° = 6/BD

=> BD = 6/√3 = 2√3

Change in length of shadow = CD = BC-BD = 4√3m

questions_hin.q_hi:
A sum of Rs. 1230 is borrowed at 5% C.l. interest for 2 years on the condition that it is refunded in 2 equal installments one at the end of the first year & the other at the end of the second. What is the

amount of each installment.

1230 रुपये की एक धनराशि को 2 वर्षो के लिए 5% की दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार लिया जाता है, जिस पर शर्त यह है कि यह 2 बराबर किस्तों अर्थात पहली किस्त को वर्ष के अंत में और दूसरी किस्त को दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में वापस किया जाना है। प्रत्येक किस्त की धनराशि कितनी है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the installments be Rs. x each

Amount to be refunded = 1230(1 + 5/100)2 = 1356.075

x(1 + 5/100) + x = 1356.075

x = Rs. 661.50

questions_hin.q_hi:
The average of three positive integers A, B and C is equal to an integer D. The average of A and D is another integer E. If the average of A and C is 5 more than E, what is the difference between D and the average of A and B?

तीन धनात्मक पूर्णांकों A, B और C का औसत एक पूर्णांक D के बराबर है। A और D का औसत एक अन्य पूर्णांक E है। यदि A और C का औसत E से 5 अधिक है, तो D और A तथा B के औसत के बीच का अंतर कितना है?

If a = (√6+ 1)/(√6-1) and b = (√6- 1)/(√6+1) Then what is the value of (a2 + b2 + ab )/(a2 + b2- ab ) ?

यदि a = (√6+ 1)/(√6-1) और b = (√6- 1)/(√6+1) है, तो (a2 + b2 + ab )/(a2 + b2- ab ) का मान कितना है?
o_hi: None of theseइनमें से कोई नहीं
questions_hin.s_hi:
We can see that; a = (√6+ 1)/(√6-1) X (√6+ 1)/(√6+1)=(7+2√6)/5

Similarly; b = (√6- 1)/(√6+1) X (√6- 1)/(√6-1)=(7-2√6)/5

Since a and b are inverse of each other hence ab = 1

Now; a2 + b2 + ab = ((7+2√6)/5)2 + ((7-2√6)/5)2 + 1 = 171/25

In the same way; a2 + b2 - ab = ((7+2√6)/5)2 + ((7-2√6)/5)2 - 1 =121/25

Hence required value = 171/121

questions_hin.q_hi:
If a rectangular sheet of paper having sides 15 cm and 44 cm is shaped in the form of a cylinder such that the side of length 15 cm becomes height of cylinder, then what will be the volume of cylinder?

यदि कागज की एक आयताकार शीट जिसकी भुजाएं 15 सेंटीमीटर और 44 सेंटीमीटर हैं, जिसे एक बेलन का आकार इस तरह से दिया जाता है कि 15 सेंटीमीटर लंबाई की भुजा बेलन की ऊंचाई बन जाती है, तो बेलन का आयतन कितना होगा?
o_hi: 2310 cm32310 घन सेंटीमीटर
2210 cm32210 घन सेंटीमीटर
2020 cm32020 घन सेंटीमीटर
None of the aboveउपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions_hin.s_hi:
After converting in to a cylinder, 44 cm is the circumference of the cylinder.

Radius= (44/(2π)) = 7 cm.

Volume of cylinder= π x (7 x 7) x 15 = 22 x 7 x 15 =330 x 7 = 2310 cm3

questions_hin.q_hi:
What is the value of expression Tan2θ + Cot2θ - Sec2θCosec2θ?

अभिव्यक्ति का मान क्या है :

Tan2θ + Cot2θ - Sec2θCosec2θ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Tan2θ + Cot2θ - Sec2θCosec2θ

=> Sin2θ/Cos2θ + Cos2θ/Sin2θ - 1/Cos2θ * 1/Sin2θ

=> [Sin4θ + Cos4θ - 1]/Sin2θ Cos2θ

=> [Sin4θ + Cos4θ + 2Sin2θCos2θ - 1 - 2Sin2θCos2θ]/Sin2θ Cos2θ

=> [(Sin2θ + Cos2θ)2 - 1 - 2Sin2θCos2θ]/Sin2θCos2θ

=> (-2Sin2θCos2θ)/Sin2θCos2θ

=> -2

questions_hin.q_hi:
In the following figure AP and AQ are two tangents and point O is the centre of the circle. Find the angle between tangent AP and AQ.

निम्नलिखित आकृति में AP और AQ दो स्पर्शरेखा हैं और बिंदु O वृत्त का केंद्र है। स्पर्शरेखा AP और AQ के बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
∠OPQ = 350 (Given)

∠OPQ = ∠OQP = 350 (Angles opposite to equal sides are also equal)

∠POQ = 1800 - 350 - 350 = 1100

∠PAQ = 1800 - ∠POQ (In quadrilateral PAQO, ∠OQA = ∠OPA = 900)

∠PAQ = 1800 - 1100 = 700

questions_hin.q_hi:
A shopkeeper marks his goods in such a way that the profit on sale of 30 refined oil packets is equal to the selling price of 15 refined oil packets. What is his profit percentage?

एक दुकानदार अपने वस्तुओं को इस तरह से चिह्नित करता है कि 30 रिफाइंड तेल पैकेटों के बिक्री पर लाभ 15 रिफाइंड तेल पैकेटों के विक्रय मूल्य के बराबर है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत कितना होगा?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let cost price of 1 refined oil packet be C

Let selling price of 1 refined oil packet be S

According to question:

30*(S - C) = 15*S

2S - 2C = S

S = 2C

Profit percent = (S-C)/C * 100 = (2C - C)/C * 100 = 100 %

questions_hin.q_hi:
If 20 men worked for 5 hours a day, they can build a 190 feet long wall in 10 days. If after working for 6 days, 4 men leave the job, then how many days will be required to complete rest of the job if the number of working hours per day is the same?

यदि 20 पुरुष प्रतिदिन 5 घंटे काम करते हैं, तो वे 10 दिनों में 190 फीट लंबी दीवार बना सकते हैं। यदि 6 दिनों के लिए काम करने के बाद, 4 पुरुष नौकरी छोड़ देते हैं और यदि प्रति दिन काम के घंटे की संख्या समान है, तो बाकी काम को पूरा करने के लिए कितने दिनों की आवश्यकता होगी?
questions_hin.s_hi:
20 men working 5 hours of a day can build a wall in 10 days.

These 20 men worked for 6 days. This implies that they have built 6/10 i.e., 60% of the wall in 6 days.

Since, the length of the wall is 190 feet, part of wall completed in 6 days = 0.6 X 190 = 114 feet

Now, Amount of wall still left = 190 - 114 = 76 feet.

Also, the number of men left = 20 - 4 = 16

The rate of working is same in both the cases.

Let the number of days now required be D.

114/76 = (20 X 5 X 6)/(16 X 5 X D)

D = 5 days

questions_hin.q_hi:
What is the unit digit of 31286 + 12529?

31286 + 12529 का इकाई का अंक क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

NumberCyclicityUnit digit values
Power 1Power 2Power 3Power 4
010
111
242486
343971
4246
515
616
747931
848426
9291

(Note: remainder = power. When remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

In 31286:

Unit digit of 312 is 2.

286: From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 2 is 4.

86/4 remainder =2 = power 2

So, unit digit of 31286 = 4

In 12529:

Unit digit of 125 is 5.

529: From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 5 is 1.

Unit digit of 12529 = 5

Therefore, unit digit of 31286 + 12529 = unit digit of (4 + 5) = 9

questions_hin.q_hi:
Sum of two numbers is equal to sum of square of 15 and cube of 7. One of the numbers is 52 less than square of 18. What is the value of the square of the difference between the numbers?

दो संख्याओं का योग, 15 के वर्ग और 7 के घन के योग के बराबर है। संख्याओं में से एक संख्या 18 के वर्ग से 52 कम है। संख्याओं के बीच के अंतर के वर्ग का मान क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the numbers be a and b.

a+b = 152 + 73 = 225+343 = 568

a = 182 - 52 = 272

=> b = 296

Required number = (296-272)2 = 576

questions_hin.q_hi:
In a 4 km race on a course of 250 m round, A overlaps B in the middle of his 5th round. By what distance will A win at the same rate of running? Given that they start simultaneously from same point and in the same direction.

250 मीटर के वृत्ताकार ट्रैक पर 4 किमी की दौड़ में, A अपने 5वें राउंड के बीच में B को पछाड़ देता है। दौड़ने की समान दर पर A कितनी दूरी से जीतेगा? यह दिया गया है कि वे समान बिंदु से और समान दिशा में एक साथ शुरू करते हैं।
o_hi: None of theseइनमें से कोई नहीं
questions_hin.s_hi:
A overlaps B in the middle of his 5th round.

So, when A runs 4(1/2) rounds, B runs only 3(1/2) rounds

(A's speed/ B's speed) = (4(1/2) / 3 (1/2)) = 9/7

When A runs 4 km, B runs 4 * (7/9) = 28/9 km

A wins by (4 - 28/9) = 8/9 km
